attempts.summary: Deployed a three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster (systemd-managed, static bootstrap) across node1 (10.100.244.10), node2 (.11), and node3 (.12) on AlmaLinux 9. Verified cross-node write/read replication, verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down and that the returning member catches up via raft, and completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart cluster/data recovery.
